title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-002-004
doc_notes: This document is a collection of archival correspondence and requests for information regarding a 1986 Japan Airlines UFO sighting, and it contains a summary of the reported encounter.

encounters.summary: Japan Airlines flight crew reported being shadowed by two belts of lights and a massive object the size of two aircraft carriers while flying over Alaska.
encounters.entity_appearance: two belts of lights and a huge spaceship the size of two aircraft carriers
